entry.title: Hybrid H/V and Array-Beamforming Site-Response Mapping of the 2024 Sichuan Sequence
entry.summary: We present a hybrid methodology combining horizontal-to-vertical spectral ratio (H/V) analysis with array-based beamforming for site-response characterisation of the 2024 Sichuan earthquake sequence. Using data from 42 broadband stations deployed between January and August 2024, we recover the near-surface velocity structure to within 5% RMS. The approach reduces the ambiguity inherent in single-method inversions and provides direct validation against co-located borehole measurements. Results confirm that surface-geology proxies underperform the physics-based hybrid map by approximately 30% across the study region.
